source.label: Bob's Guide to Big Show / Circus

strategy.summary: Plunge the top-center lane to light all six white rollovers. Keep returning the ball to the top and build bonus to 19K. Protect the doubled bonus on balls 3 and 5.

quickInfo.name: Top-center skill shot
quickInfo.summary: The top-center lane lights all six white rollover disks for bonus advances.

quickInfo.name: Side top lanes
quickInfo.summary: A side top lane lights only the three white rollovers on that side.

quickInfo.name: Bonus switches
quickInfo.summary: Six lit white rollovers, two yellow standups, and two return lanes advance bonus toward 19K.

quickInfo.name: Fixed Double Bonus
quickInfo.summary: The game doubles the built bonus on balls 3 and 5 only.

quickInfo.name: 15K Extra Ball
quickInfo.summary: Extra Ball lights only while the bonus is exactly 15K and is usually disabled for competition.

steps.text: Plunge for the top-center lane to light all six white rollover disks.
Return the ball to the top through the safer orbit or upper-playfield feed.
Use the lit white rollovers to advance bonus without shooting the lower standups.
Let safe return-lane and yellow-target hits add bonus.
Build bonus to 19K. On balls 3 and 5, protect the doubled end-of-ball collect.
modeNotes: Fixed Double Bonus: Balls 3 and 5 double the built bonus. No shot enables Double Bonus on the other balls.

steps.text: After bonus reaches 19K, continue top play for the side-bumper scoring.

fallback.title: Relight the white rollovers
fallback.when: Use this when the plunge misses all three top lanes or lights only one side.

steps.text: Return the ball to the top through the safer orbit.
Try to enter the top-center lane or the unlit side lane.
Use a light-lanes standup only when the rebound is controlled.
Resume lit-rollover bonus scoring after the needed lamps turn on.

alternatives.title: Exact-15K Extra Ball
alternatives.when: Use this only when Extra Ball is enabled and bonus has reached exactly 15K.

steps.text: Stop bonus advances when the bonus reaches 15K.
Confirm that Extra Ball is lit.
Take the Extra Ball shot only when its feed is safer than continued top play.
Ignore this route when the award is disabled or replaced.
Plunge the top-center lane to light all six white rollovers.
Advance bonus through lit white rollovers and return lanes.
Carry the 38K collect to the end of ball 3 or ball 5.

techniques.name: Top-center skill plunge
techniques.instruction: Set the plunge strength for the top-center lane. This lane lights all six bonus rollovers at once.

techniques.name: Side-orbit feed nudge
techniques.instruction: Watch the ball at the post below the lowest white rollover. Use a small nudge to guide it toward a flipper.

techniques.name: Center-gap recovery
techniques.instruction: Prepare both flippers when the ball follows the angled center rubber. Nudge only enough to avoid a lower slingshot or side drain.

cautions.issue: The outer top routes have no gates, so a plunge can miss all three top lanes.
cautions.response: Record the working plunge strength during practice. Use top returns before you risk a light-lanes standup.

cautions.issue: The yellow bonus targets and the standups that light the white rollovers can return the ball dangerously.
cautions.response: Prefer repeated top play. Shoot a standup only when the needed lamp justifies the rebound risk.

cautions.issue: A ball leaving the upper area can reach a lower slingshot or drain at the side.
cautions.response: Read both orbit feeds early. Stop repeating the route that reaches a slingshot without flipper control.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm two-player Big Show or four-player Circus, ball count, tilt, replay and Extra Ball treatment, and whether balls 3 and 5 double bonus.
Confirm all six white rollover lamps, both light-lanes standups, yellow bonus targets, return-lane switches, the 19K maximum, and exact-15K Extra Ball behavior.
Test the top-center plunge, both side top lanes, upper returns, post and slingshot positions, side drains, and each orbit feed to the flippers.
strategy.simpleOverview: Big Show and Circus use a top-center plunge to light six white rollovers that build end-of-ball bonus. Plunge the center lane, keep returning the ball upstairs, and reach 19K before the fixed Double Bonus on balls 3 and 5.
strategy.overview: Big Show and Circus are built around a 19K end-of-ball bonus. Plunge the top-center lane to light all six white rollovers, then raise the bonus through those rollovers, the return lanes, and the two yellow standups. Preserve the built bonus on balls 3 and 5, when the game automatically doubles it to 38K.

Confirm all six white rollover lamps, both light-lanes standups, yellow bonus targets, return-lane switches, the 19K maximum, and exact-15K Extra Ball behavior.
Test the top-center plunge, both side top lanes, upper returns, post and slingshot positions, side drains, and each orbit feed to the flippers.
